catchments.citation: Lehner, B., Grill G. (2013). Global river hydrography and network routing: baseline data and new approaches to study the world's large river systems. Hydrological Processes, 27(15): 2171–2186.
catchments.notes: Level-8 sub-basin units derived from 15 arc-second HydroSHEDS elevation data. They are hydrological units, not administrative districts, and they are not flood inundation extents.

rivers.notes: Reaches with upstream area ≥10 km² or average flow ≥0.1 m³/s. DIS_AV_CMS is a long-term modelled average, not a live gauge.
